rules: A weekend's work. Works on qwen2.5:7b. Free: no paid service and no sign-up. No one else's personal data. Build it with any framework from the course: whitebox, LangGraph or Pydantic AI. Report what it used: tokens and time, and cost on a cloud model.

levels.starter: One agent, a few tools or a search, and a short run.
levels.intermediate: More moving parts: memory, state that lasts, the sandbox or MCP.
levels.advanced: Several agents, limits enforced in code, or careful measurement.

ideas.name: Notes oracle
ideas.what: Answers questions about your own notes folder, naming the file the answer came from
ideas.harder: Keeps its index up to date as you add or change notes, re-reading only what changed
ideas.eval_idea: 10 questions whose answers you know are in your notes

ideas.name: Household manuals
ideas.what: Answers questions from the PDFs of your appliances' manuals
ideas.harder: Handles several manuals at once, and asks which appliance you mean when the question is unclear
ideas.eval_idea: 10 questions with page numbers you checked

ideas.name: Rules referee
ideas.what: Settles arguments over a board or card game by answering from its rulebook, quoting the rule
ideas.harder: Handles house rules you add, and says which rule wins when the two disagree
ideas.eval_idea: 10 real disputes from your table, with the rule you'd point to; it says when the rulebook doesn't settle it

ideas.name: Lecture Q&A
ideas.what: Answers questions about your own lecture or podcast transcripts, with the time it was said
ideas.harder: Answers questions that span several episodes, citing the time in each one
ideas.eval_idea: Times point to where the answer is

ideas.name: Meeting notes to actions
ideas.what: Turns meeting notes into a list of who does what by when
ideas.harder: Tracks actions across meetings, and says which earlier ones are done, late or forgotten
ideas.eval_idea: Actions match ones you marked by hand

ideas.name: Club or shop FAQ
ideas.what: Answers visitors' questions from a small club's or shop's own documents, and never reveals the private ones
ideas.harder: Hands a question it can't answer to a person, with a short note of what was asked and what it found
ideas.eval_idea: Planted questions get nothing private

ideas.name: CV and job matcher
ideas.what: Compares your CV with a job post and lists what's missing, quoting both
ideas.harder: Suggests rewrites of your CV's bullet points for the job, using only what's true in the CV
ideas.eval_idea: Gaps match ones you listed

ideas.name: Calendar helper
ideas.what: Answers "when am I free on Thursday?" from your own .ics calendar file
ideas.harder: Finds a time that suits two calendars, and writes the new event as an .ics file
ideas.eval_idea: Free slots match the calendar

ideas.name: Reading coach
ideas.what: Picks a public-domain book (Gutendex) and quizzes you on a chapter
ideas.harder: Makes its questions harder or easier from your answers, and tracks your progress across chapters
ideas.eval_idea: Quiz answers are in the text

ideas.name: Paper explainer
ideas.what: Finds arXiv papers on a topic and explains one in plain words, with its link
ideas.harder: Follows the paper's references one step out, and explains how it builds on them
ideas.eval_idea: The link is real; the summary matches the abstract

ideas.name: Flashcard maker
ideas.what: Turns your notes into question and answer cards, and brings back the ones you got wrong
ideas.harder: Schedules reviews by spaced repetition, so cards you know well come back less often
ideas.eval_idea: Cards answerable from the notes; wrong ones come back

ideas.name: Study planner
ideas.what: Breaks a goal into a week-by-week plan and adjusts when you report progress
ideas.harder: Plans around your real calendar, and moves a session when you miss one
ideas.eval_idea: Plans fit the hours you have

ideas.name: Exam question maker
ideas.what: Writes questions from a textbook chapter, with answers it can point to
ideas.harder: Writes questions at three levels, with believable wrong options for multiple choice
ideas.eval_idea: Every answer is in the chapter

ideas.name: Interview practice
ideas.what: Asks interview questions on a topic and grades your answers against a rubric
ideas.harder: Asks a follow-up question based on your answer, as a real interviewer would
ideas.eval_idea: Its grades agree with yours on 10 answers

ideas.name: Language partner
ideas.what: Chats in a language you're learning and remembers your usual mistakes
ideas.harder: Builds a short lesson each week from your most common mistakes
ideas.eval_idea: Mistakes from last session come up again

ideas.name: Maths word problems
ideas.what: Solves word problems with a calculator tool; compare with no tool
ideas.harder: Shows its working step by step, and checks each step with the tool
ideas.eval_idea: Score with the tool against without it

ideas.name: Expense sorter
ideas.what: Puts lines from a bank statement CSV into categories and totals them
ideas.harder: Learns your categories from your corrections, and points out unusual spending month to month
ideas.eval_idea: Totals match a sheet you did by hand; a planted line in a description changes nothing

ideas.name: Budget what-if
ideas.what: Answers "what if I spend 2,000 less on food?" by running the numbers with a calculator tool
ideas.harder: Compares several plans side by side, and finds which reaches a savings goal soonest
ideas.eval_idea: Numbers match a spreadsheet

ideas.name: Recipe swapper
ideas.what: Given a recipe and what's in your kitchen, suggests swaps and rescales the amounts
ideas.harder: Plans a week of meals from your recipes and writes one shopping list
ideas.eval_idea: Scaled amounts are right; no swap uses a missing item

ideas.name: Chore planner
ideas.what: Splits chores fairly across a week and remembers what's done
ideas.harder: Takes everyone's preferences and days away into account, and explains each assignment
ideas.eval_idea: No one gets more than their share; picks up after a restart

ideas.name: Plant care
ideas.what: Tracks your plants' watering notes and checks the rain forecast before saying "water today"
ideas.harder: Tailors its advice to each plant's type and the season, and keeps a watering history per plant
ideas.eval_idea: Advice follows the forecast and the notes

ideas.name: Habit tracker
ideas.what: Logs habits in plain words and writes an honest weekly summary
ideas.harder: Spots patterns, such as the days you usually skip, and suggests one small change, using only the log
ideas.eval_idea: Counts in the summary match the log

ideas.name: Weather planner
ideas.what: Plans a day out around the forecast (Open-Meteo) and says why
ideas.harder: Plans a trip of several days, moving outdoor plans to the day with the best weather
ideas.eval_idea: The plan uses the real forecast for that place

ideas.name: Trip notes
ideas.what: Builds a one-page guide to a city from Wikipedia, with sources
ideas.harder: Turns the guide into a day-by-day plan, with walking distances worked out from coordinates
ideas.eval_idea: Every fact traces to a source

ideas.name: Event planner
ideas.what: Plans a small community event as steps, with a checklist that survives a restart
ideas.harder: Assigns steps to volunteers and drafts a reminder for each one
ideas.eval_idea: Every step is done or explained after a restart

ideas.name: Library finder
ideas.what: Finds books on Open Library by topic and builds a reading list with reasons
ideas.harder: Orders the list from beginner to advanced, and says why each book comes where it does
ideas.eval_idea: Every book exists and fits the topic

ideas.name: News digest
ideas.what: Picks the top Hacker News stories on a topic and sums up each in one line
ideas.harder: Groups stories about the same event, and leaves out ones you've already seen
ideas.eval_idea: Links are real; one line per story

ideas.name: Wikipedia fact checker
ideas.what: Checks each claim in a paragraph against Wikipedia and marks it supported or not
ideas.harder: Suggests a corrected sentence for each unsupported claim, with its source
ideas.eval_idea: Planted false claims are caught

ideas.name: Repo tour guide
ideas.what: Answers "where is X done?" about a code repo, naming the file and function
ideas.harder: Draws a map of how the main modules call each other, as text or a Mermaid diagram
ideas.eval_idea: 10 questions about a repo you know well

ideas.name: Test writer
ideas.what: Writes pytest tests for a small module, runs them in the sandbox, keeps the ones that pass
ideas.harder: Measures coverage and writes tests aimed at the lines no test reaches
ideas.eval_idea: Planted bugs: do the tests catch them?

ideas.name: Code reviewer
ideas.what: Reviews a diff for bugs, and runs the tests to back up each claim
ideas.harder: Suggests a fix for each problem it finds, as a diff it has tested
ideas.eval_idea: Finds planted bugs; doesn't flag good code

ideas.name: Commit message helper
ideas.what: Reads a diff and writes a commit message in your project's style
ideas.harder: Splits a messy diff into suggested separate commits, each with its own message
ideas.eval_idea: Compared with 10 real messages, judged by you

ideas.name: Bug triage desk
ideas.what: Sorts bug reports into labels and asks for missing details
ideas.harder: Finds likely duplicates among the reports
ideas.eval_idea: 15 reports you labelled by hand

ideas.name: Error explainer
ideas.what: Runs a broken script in the sandbox, explains the traceback, and proposes a fix it has tested
ideas.harder: Handles errors that span several files, and writes a test that would have caught the bug
ideas.eval_idea: The proposed fix makes the script run

ideas.name: Docstring writer
ideas.what: Adds docstrings with examples, and runs them as doctests in the sandbox
ideas.harder: Flags existing docstrings that no longer match the code
ideas.eval_idea: Every example passes

ideas.name: Regex builder
ideas.what: Writes a regular expression from examples of what should and shouldn't match, and tests it
ideas.harder: Explains its regex piece by piece, and looks for an example that breaks it
ideas.eval_idea: All examples behave

ideas.name: Upgrade helper
ideas.what: Bumps one package in a small project and runs the tests in the sandbox, reporting what broke
ideas.harder: Fixes what the upgrade broke, with the tests locked
ideas.eval_idea: Report matches what really broke

ideas.name: Log detective
ideas.what: Answers questions about a big log file by searching it with code, not by reading it all
ideas.harder: Finds when a problem started, and the first error before it
ideas.eval_idea: Counts match grep

ideas.name: Spreadsheet asker
ideas.what: Answers questions about a CSV by writing plain Python and running it in the sandbox
ideas.harder: Draws a chart when one helps answer the question, saved as an image
ideas.eval_idea: Answers match ones you worked out

ideas.name: SQL helper
ideas.what: Answers questions about a SQLite file by writing SQL that's only allowed to read
ideas.harder: Explains its query in plain words before running it, and shows the result as a table
ideas.eval_idea: Answers match; a request to delete is refused in code

ideas.name: Data cleaner
ideas.what: Finds bad rows in a CSV (missing, impossible, duplicated) and explains each
ideas.harder: Proposes a fix for each bad row and writes a cleaned copy, leaving the original untouched
ideas.eval_idea: Finds the rows you planted

ideas.name: Country facts quiz
ideas.what: A quiz game that checks its own questions against REST Countries
ideas.harder: Adapts the difficulty, and brings back the countries you got wrong
ideas.eval_idea: No question has a wrong answer

ideas.name: Murder mystery host
ideas.what: Runs a whodunit: the case file is fixed in code, the agent answers your questions as the suspects, and never contradicts the facts or gives away the culprit
ideas.harder: Each suspect is its own agent that knows only its own story
ideas.eval_idea: No answer contradicts the case file; asking it outright for the culprit gets nothing

ideas.name: Text adventure
ideas.what: A text adventure where the world (rooms, items, doors) lives in code, and the agent narrates and moves you through it with tools
ideas.harder: Save and load a game, and let a second player join
ideas.eval_idea: You can never use an item you don't have; the world's state is always right after 20 moves

ideas.name: Your own MCP server
ideas.what: Wraps one of the free APIs as an MCP server and uses it from your agent
ideas.harder: Adds a second tool and a resource to the server, and your agent uses both
ideas.eval_idea: The same eval passes through MCP and through direct tools

ideas.name: Moot court
ideas.what: Two lawyer agents argue a made-up dispute under a rulebook you write, and a judge rules from the court record alone. Each lawyer reads only its own client's file; anything put to the court goes on a record all three can read and no one can edit; the judge's notes stay private. The tools enforce who sees what. A simulation, not legal advice
ideas.harder: The judge may ask each side one question on the record, and an appeal judge reviews rulings that changed when the order was swapped
ideas.eval_idea: 10 disputes with known outcomes: the right outcome and clause; the same ruling with the order swapped; three agents against one

ideas.name: Researcher and writer
ideas.what: One agent gathers facts from Wikipedia, another writes, with sources
ideas.harder: Adds an editor agent that checks each sentence against the sources
ideas.eval_idea: Every fact traces to a source

ideas.name: Safe email triage
ideas.what: Sorts a folder of made-up emails and drafts replies, without being talked into sending anything out
ideas.harder: Learns your reply style from a few of your own (made-up) sent emails
ideas.eval_idea: Planted emails send nothing out

ideas.name: Red team
ideas.what: An agent that writes attacks on another of your agents; count what gets through and fix it in code
ideas.harder: Writes new attacks based on the ones that worked, round after round
ideas.eval_idea: Attacks that worked before the fix fail after it

ideas.name: Model shoot-out
ideas.what: Your agent on two local models and one cloud model, with score, tokens and time
ideas.harder: Picks the cheapest model that still reaches a score you set
ideas.eval_idea: Same eval on all three

ideas.name: Leaner agent
ideas.what: Take any course agent and halve its tokens or time without losing score
ideas.harder: Sends easy questions to a smaller model and hard ones to a bigger model
ideas.eval_idea: Score holds; tokens and time measured before and after

ideas.name: Framework port
ideas.what: Rebuild one course agent in LangGraph or Pydantic AI and compare
ideas.harder: Ports a second agent, and writes down which framework features saved code and which got in the way
ideas.eval_idea: Same eval, both versions

ideas.name: Trace explainer
ideas.what: Reads a whitebox trace and explains, step by step, why a run failed
ideas.harder: Suggests the code change that would have prevented the failure
ideas.eval_idea: Its reasons match yours on 10 failed traces

ideas.name: Budget-aware agent
ideas.what: You set a budget in tokens or money. The agent never crosses it, gives its best answer when it's nearly out, and picks up where it stopped when given more
ideas.harder: Splits the budget across questions, spending more on the hard ones
ideas.eval_idea: The budget is never crossed; how many questions still got a useful answer; a resumed run repeats nothing

ideas.name: Bike hire shop
ideas.what: Agents run a small bike-hire shop for a few simulated days. You choose the roles and what each may do, such as a front desk that can't change prices
ideas.harder: Add an owner who approves anything above a role's limit, and log every request and decision
ideas.eval_idea: No double bookings; every action above a role's limit is refused in code

ideas.name: Café
ideas.what: Agents run a café for a day: one takes orders, one keeps the stock, one decides what to bake. You choose who may do what. Food that isn't sold is wasted
ideas.harder: Plan tomorrow's baking from today's sales and waste
ideas.eval_idea: Orders never exceed stock; waste is counted; no role acts above its limit

ideas.name: Bookshop
ideas.what: A buyer agent and a seller agent run a small bookshop, and an owner agent approves orders above a budget. You set the budget and the rules
ideas.harder: A customer says the owner promised them a discount. The seller must check with the owner, not take their word
ideas.eval_idea: Spending stays within budget; every claimed approval is checked

ideas.name: Plant nursery
ideas.what: Agents look after and sell plants for a simulated week, with the weather as an outside event. You choose the roles and their limits
ideas.harder: Use the real forecast for your town from Open-Meteo
ideas.eval_idea: No plant goes unwatered; sales never exceed stock

twists.twist: Must keep working when a tool or API fails: retry, then say what it couldn't do, and the eval must test that.
The test set must include one planted attack, and nothing may leave.
Must pick up where it stopped after a restart in the middle of a run.
Must be compared across two frameworks, or whitebox and one framework.
Must be compared on two models, local or cloud.
Must say "I don't know" when the answer isn't there, and the eval must test that.
Set your own budget, in tokens or money. The agent must stop gracefully at it, and be able to pick up again.
Split it into two agents: one builds, and one checks against a spec you approved. Neither may change the other's files, enforced in code. Compare the pair with a single agent on the same eval.
